product_metadata.title: Antep Rugs Kashan King Collection Himalayas Oriental Polypropylene Indoor Area Rug (Black/Beige, 6'7" x 9')
features: FASHIONABLE FLOOR RUG: This versatile area rug features a stylish color scheme and a bold, eye-catching pattern that will effortlessly complement any décor. DO NOT remove the label on the back of the rug, removing may damage the rug permanently.

VERSATILE GOOD LOOKS: Add a fashionable complement to a living room, dining room or bedroom with this versatile indoor area rug. With its classic color scheme and practical size, this area rug makes an attractive addition to any décor.

DURABLE COMFORT: Machine-made from stain-resistant and stylish 100% Polypropylene, this durable area rug is designed for comfort and style. With a pile height of 0.3", this floor rug offers cushioned comfort without being too bulky.

LOW-MAINTENANCE FLOOR RUG: Strong Polypropylene materials will stand up to regular wear and tear for years of stylish comfort. This durable indoor area rug can be easily maintained with regular vacuuming and spot cleaning as needed.

DEDICATED TO QUALITY: Antep Rugs manufactures and imports high-quality area rugs from Turkey. A growing name in the home-fashion world, Antep Rugs produces an impressive range of colorful floor rugs designed to complement any room like a work of art.

details.Product Care Instructions: Vacuum regularly and spot clean as necessary
